core_meaning.primary_meaning: Harb is an Arabic-origin name meaning “War, battle, campaign”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Harb corresponds to the Arabic form حرب (Arabic root ح ر ب (ḥ-r-b); حَرْب (Ḥarb)). Its core sense is war, battle, campaign. Harb is Arabic حَرْب (Ḥarb) 'war, battle, campaign', from the root ح ر ب (ḥ-r-b). It is a documented pre-Islamic and early Islamic personal name (for example Ḥarb ibn Umayya). The source gloss 'war, battle, campaign' is correct.
